name: In re SitusAMC Holdings Corporation Data Breach Litigation Settlement
summary: Settlement resolving claims over a November 2025 data breach at SitusAMC. Offers about $75 cash with no proof, or up to $5,000 for documented losses, plus a year of credit monitoring.

eligibilityQuestions.text: Did you receive a data breach notification from SitusAMC (or The Lash Group) about an incident from around November 12, 2025?
Do you reside in the United States?

claimFields.label: Login ID from your settlement notice (required by the official site to file online)
